name: Rotary Feros Health Student Grants
summary: Grants towards rural, regional or remote clinical placements for full-time QUT health students.
key: $1,650 each, paid when the approved clinical placement starts.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Enrolled or on track to enrol in an eligible clinical unit, such as Paramedic Science, Radiation Therapy, Nutrition and Dietetics, Exercise Physiology, Podiatry, Optometry or Medical Imaging.
how: Apply with the application form, a CV and a written response of up to 1,000 words on yourself and your intended learning outcomes.
catches: One grant per student over your time at QUT.
The terms don't give the closing date. Ask health.engage@qut.edu.au.
